$comment: The corporate bed, for the polished episodes (owner feedback after the take-5 review: the bed was jarring; asked for modern product-video music, upbeat but unhurried, warm and polished). Use it with SA_MUSIC_JSON=video/brand/music-v3.json for build, mix and verify; music.json stays the series bed and music-calm.json stays an option until the owner decides. Same rules as music.json (track.file is relative to the media root and never in git; mix.py refuses any other file by SHA-256). track.mix asks the mixer for a lower bed: 7 dB under the voice (by integrated loudness over the whole video) and a further 6 dB while it speaks; measured per VO line the bed sits 12.4 to 15.9 dB under it. track.xfade is the length of each splice's crossfade in seconds (1.5: a slow blend, every splice lands on the same chord).

track.title: Spatial Adjust corporate bed
track.library: None: composed and synthesised in code in this repository

measured.tool: by construction: the generator places every chord and every drum hit on the 96 BPM bar grid (loop_points.py is not needed)
